items.title: KXTV channel 10 Sacramento last 2 hours of analog 6/12/09
items.description: Here's the last 2 hours of KXTV channel 10's analog broadcast on June 12, 2009. They were the last full-power station in Sacramento to stay on the air, all others had gone off the air earlier, KCRA and KVIE had switched to running the "Nightlight" loop for a month which I sadly don't have copies of.
